notes:
# v1.4.5 - Indonesian Hits restored and fresher recommendations

- Fixed: the "Indonesian Hits" row on Home is no longer empty. When the
  Preferred Content Region was set to a region other than Indonesian, that row
  was filtered down to nothing; a labelled row now always shows its own sources
  regardless of the region preference.
- Fixed: recommendations no longer repeat the same titles across rows. One
  series could appear in Recommended for You, Because you read, More Genre and a
  type row at the same time; each title now appears in only one row.
- Improved: building recommendations no longer makes a duplicate provider
  request, so the Home rails load a little faster.
- Note: no action needed on your part - just update and enjoy.
